security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http: https:; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval'

bundle.shortDescription: A private, approval-first desktop companion for Smara
bundle.longDescription: Smara Desktop runs its source-owned native agent harness with your selected model provider, separate local projects, saved sessions, explicit approvals and workspace sandboxing. Native settings manage DPAPI-protected credentials. Public research, local-memory readers, isolated workers and public DOM browsing are opt-in. Historical data remains untouched; old execution engines are not included.
